rules.title: Residential Rental Property Application Fee Cap
rules.requirement: A landlord or agent cannot charge an application or similar fee of more than $50 to apply to lease or sublease a residential rental property, except for certain exempt dwellings.
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to residential rental property dwelling units generally, with specific exemptions.
rules.exemptions: Does not apply to a dwelling unit located in a one-family or two-family dwelling offered for rent, or to a licensee of the New Jersey Real Estate Commission unless that licensee is the landlord.
rules.penalty: Civil penalty of up to $500 for a first offense, up to $750 for a second offense, and up to $1,000 for each subsequent offense, collected under the Penalty Enforcement Law of 1999; wrongfully charged amount remitted to the applicant.
rules.quoted_span:
A landlord, or
agent thereof, shall not require an application or other similar fee to apply
to lease or sublease a residential rental property for dwelling purposes, which
exceeds $50.

coverage.other_unknown_factor: whether the landlord or agent is a licensee of the New Jersey Real Estate Commission acting other than as landlord
